purpose: Test whether a non-tuned equal-probability blend reduces representation-specific errors on the already opened v12 CIFAKE and SID diagnostic gates.
boundaries: The weights are fixed and are not searched on either gate.
Both gates have already been opened, so this is a diagnostic and cannot be called fresh promotion evidence.
The SID gate is source-confounded and cannot overrule the matched-source CIFAKE result.
A numerical pass does not establish hidden-set transfer and does not replace the preserved v6 fallback by itself.
No organizer demo-only data are used.
